notes.title: Double It - New Update v1.2
notes.content: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45609896/4ff20e24113fae9dad098170bbde4e33160cf8e6.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Update Notes – Double It[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]New Game Modes Added:[/b] [i]Team Mode[/i] and [i]Hidden Money Mode[/i].[/p][list][*][p]In [b]Team Mode[/b], team up with your partner to eliminate other players.[/p][/*][*][p]In [b]Hidden Money Mode[/b], player balances remain hidden until the end of the round.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Target-Lock[/b] option added to lobby settings. When disabled, you can choose any player to target at the end of a round instead of automatically targeting the one with the least money.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dead Talk[/b] option added to lobby settings. When enabled, eliminated players can continue chatting.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Drone Skins[/b] added.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Legendary Masks[/b] added.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Map:[/b] [i]Liminal Park[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Added visual effects for [b]Epic[/b] and [b]Legendary[/b] rarity Fidget Spinners.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Drones can now battle each other[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Added several new [b]Easter Eggs[/b]! :)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug fixes[/b] and performance improvements.[/p][/*][/list]
